title: 主体段的论据展开
goal: 能选择解释论点的支持句，并判断例证是否相关。

points.label: 选择能解释论点的支持句
判断例证与论点是否相关

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 写作主体段课的内容与教学规格

cards.title: 结构
rows: Evening access allows workers to visit after work.
For example, a shift worker could borrow books after a late shift.
比较不同条件下的结果
Without evening access, that worker might be unable to visit.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: Evening access helps workers because they can visit after work.
The library opens later; as a result, workers can visit after work.
For example, a shift worker could visit after work.
Without evening opening, the worker might miss the service.

body.p: 因果解释写出从措施到结果的过程。开放时段和反馈速度两段都是这种写法。

body.box: Flexible library hours can make borrowing more accessible to workers. When a branch opens after the working day, people who cannot visit at lunchtime have another opportunity to enter. A shift worker, for example, could collect a reserved book in the evening. This additional opportunity makes the service available at a time that fits the worker's schedule, rather than requiring time off from work.

Timely feedback can improve a student's next draft. When comments arrive while a task is still being revised, the student can identify an unclear point and change it before submission. For instance, a tutor might indicate that a paragraph lacks evidence. The student could then add a relevant example, making the relationship between the claim and its support clearer in the final version.

body.p: 具体情境把论点放进一个假设的场景。场景里的人做了什么、结果如何，都要和论点相关。

body.box: Shared tools can reduce the need for individual purchases. Consider a resident who needs a drill for a single repair but does not expect to use it regularly. A local lending service could provide the tool for that task. The resident would still complete the repair, while avoiding the cost and storage space involved in owning equipment that would otherwise remain unused.

Clear signs can help visitors navigate a large building. Imagine a person arriving for an appointment at an unfamiliar clinic. A sign at the entrance could point towards the relevant reception desk, and another sign could mark the correct corridor. These instructions give the visitor a route to follow and reduce reliance on asking staff for directions at each junction.

body.p: 对照结果比较有这个条件和没有这个条件时的情况。两种情况都要围绕同一个论点。

body.box: A sheltered waiting area can make a bus stop more useful in poor weather. A passenger with a shelter can wait out of the rain while watching for the bus. Without one, the same passenger may need to wait elsewhere or become wet. The contrast concerns the comfort and practicality of waiting, not a claim that the shelter changes the timetable.

Advance notice can help households prepare for a water interruption. If the notice arrives beforehand, residents can fill containers for essential use. Without notice, they may discover the interruption only when the tap stops running. Comparing the two situations shows how information changes the opportunity to prepare, even though the notice itself does not prevent the planned interruption from taking place.

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: Flexible hours help because flexibility is helpful.
解释时间与使用机会的关系
The library has a blue roof.
Exactly 87% of workers need evening loans.
Hours are useful. Hours are beneficial.

items.stem: Claim: Evening library hours help workers use the service. Which sentence explains the claim?
options: Workers can visit after their working day ends.
Library hours help because useful hours are helpful.
Workers can visit the library during their lunch break.
Evening hours are evenings when libraries open.
items.why: 第一项解释晚间开放如何提供工作后的访问机会。

items.stem: Claim: A tool-lending service can reduce purchases. Which example is relevant?
options: A resident buys several drills for regular work.
A resident borrows a drill for a single repair.
A resident borrows a book on repairing walls.
A resident stores purchased tools in a cupboard.
items.why: 第二项中借用满足一次性需求，说明为何可以少买工具。

items.stem: Claim: Advance notice helps households prepare for a water interruption. Which sentence explains the link?
options: A water interruption is an interruption of water.
Residents notice the interruption when the tap stops.
Residents can fill containers before the supply stops.
Water systems are discussed before interruptions occur.
items.why: 第三项说明提前通知提供了储水准备的机会。

items.stem: Claim: Signs help visitors find a clinic reception. Which example is relevant?
options: A visitor asks staff for directions at each corner.
A visitor arrives early for a clinic appointment.
A visitor reads a sign about the clinic's opening hours.
A visitor follows entrance signs to the reception desk.
items.why: 第四项中访客跟着入口的标识走到接待处，直接说明标识如何帮助找路。第三项的标识与找接待处无关。

groups.text: A covered bus stop can make waiting more practical in rain. A passenger waiting under the roof can watch for the bus without standing in the rain. Without a roof, the same passenger might need to wait away from the stop. This comparison concerns the waiting conditions, rather than the bus timetable.

items.stem: Which sentence explains the claim about waiting?
options: A bus stop is a place where buses stop.
A roof lets a passenger wait out of the rain.
Passengers may have different bus timetables.
A roof means the bus arrives more regularly in rain.
items.why: 材料指出屋顶使乘客避雨并观察公交，第二项解释了便利。

options: A passenger checks the timetable at a covered stop.
A passenger waits under the roof on a dry day.
A passenger waits under the roof while it rains.
A passenger boards a bus at an uncovered stop.
items.why: 材料说乘客在屋顶下等车 without standing in the rain。第三项是下雨时在屋顶下等车，直接体现论点；第二项没有下雨。

groups.text:
Some people argue that public libraries should offer evening opening hours for people who work during the day. Others believe that existing daytime hours are sufficient. To what extent do you agree or disagree with providing an evening service? Give reasons and use relevant examples to support your view.

Claim: Evening opening can improve access for workers who cannot visit during the day.

items.stem: Which sentence explains how the proposed hours improve access?
options: Workers can visit after their shifts have ended.
Daytime hours already suit most library users.
Evening opening is useful because it is beneficial.
Libraries have opening hours on different days.
items.why: 工作结束后可访问图书馆，解释了工作时间与开放时间的关系。

items.stem: Which example directly supports the claim?
options: A retired resident visits the library each morning.
A worker borrows a book after an afternoon shift.
A worker visits a library during a day off.
A worker returns a book during a lunch break.
items.why: 第二项展示无法日间访问的工作者在下班后借书。

items.stem: Complete a sentence explaining the access benefit.
items.why: 晚间开放提供工作结束后的访问机会。
工作后借书是支持晚间开放的具体情境。

groups.text:
Some people believe that towns should provide a shared tool-lending service for residents who occasionally need equipment. Others prefer individual ownership and question whether such a service is necessary. Do you agree or disagree with providing shared tools? Give reasons for your position and include relevant examples.

Claim: Shared tools can reduce purchases made for a single task.

options: Residents can keep equipment they have purchased.
Tools are useful because useful equipment is helpful.
Borrowing provides the equipment without buying it.
Owning tools lets residents use them whenever they like.
items.why: 借用能满足使用需求而无需购买，解释了减少购买的机制。

options: A resident buys a drill for frequent paid work.
A resident paints a room with an owned brush.
A resident buys a drill for one home repair.
A resident borrows a drill for one home repair.
items.why: 一次性修理时借用电钻，直接说明共享工具如何替代购买。

items.stem: Complete an explanation of the claim.
items.why: 借用提供使用机会，同时省去购买。
一次性修理借用工具是与论点相关的情境。
